title: Complex-Needs Bridge Visits on Carried Referrals (Primary Care Provider Assignment)
content:
**Clause — bridge visits for members with complex needs.** When a specialist referral issued under an earlier Primary Care Provider Assignment is carried onto the member's current assignment, bridge visits are added to the visits left on the carried referral, before the single-referral visit ceiling is applied to the carried visits.

Bridge visits turn on two facts from the member's records:

- **Eligibility category.** The member's **Medicaid Managed Care Membership** is in the **Prairie Ridge ABD Care** or **Prairie Ridge Dual Complete** eligibility category.
- **Home health authorization.** The member holds a **Home Health Services Authorization** in approved status under **Prior Authorization**.

A member who meets both conditions receives the **two-visit** bridge (2 visits); a member who meets exactly one of the two conditions receives the **one-visit** bridge (1 visit); a member who meets neither receives no bridge visit.

**Truth table**

| Membership category is Prairie Ridge ABD Care or Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | Approved Home Health Services Authorization held | Bridge visits added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 2 |
| Yes | No | 1 |
| No | Yes | 1 |
| No | No | 0 |

**Illustrations (hypothetical members)**

- A member in Prairie Ridge Dual Complete with an approved Home Health Services Authorization: 2 bridge visits.
- A member in Prairie Ridge ABD Care whose Home Health Services Authorization is still submitted, not approved: one condition met, 1 bridge visit.
- A member in Prairie Ridge Family Care with an approved Home Health Services Authorization: one condition met, 1 bridge visit.
- A member in Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult with no Home Health Services Authorization: no bridge visit.
